note: The South Lebanon Water Establishment's own account of its repair work, taken from its public Facebook posts. Self-published and unverified: it is what one utility says it did, useful precisely because almost nothing else reports at this granularity.

samples.text: Establishment teams repaired a water leak on a line in the town of Al-Sultaniyeh, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.
Maintenance teams completed repair of a distribution line on the Batoulay network, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.
Establishment teams repaired a water leak on a distribution line in the town of Kafra, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.
Establishment teams completed repair of a distribution line at the Jumblatt roundabout, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.
Establishment teams repaired a water leak on a distribution line in the town of Qabrikha, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.
Maintenance teams completed repair of several 63 mm distribution lines in the town of Srifa, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.
Maintenance teams completed repair of a 3-inch distribution line on the network of the town of Seddiqine, and water supply to subscribers has been restored.

Establishment teams completed repair of a pumping line and installation of a 4-inch Gibault coupling in the town of Deir Qanoun al-Nahr, and water supply has been restored to subscribers and to those sheltering there.

caveats: Self-published. Every line is the utility's own claim about its own work, with no independent check and no photograph or contract behind it here.

Undated. The export carried no date field, so no post can be placed against the 31 July 2026 cut-off, and the file's own summary states it cannot be confirmed that all of them fall after 2 March 2026.
Not linkable. The export carried no post URLs, so individual posts cannot be cited or checked one by one - only the page as a whole.
Three posts appeared twice in the source and the second copy of each was removed, leaving 603 of the 606 supplied.
Department labels are the utility's own. The match from a post to a cadastral town is ours, made on place-name matching, and is approximate.
A repair is not reconstruction. Restoring supply to a line says nothing about whether the houses on it are standing or the people are back.
